metadata.task: Collect all books from the coffee table, place them on the bookshelf, arrange the cushions on the sofa, and return to the living room entrance.

plan.goal: Collect all books from the coffee table, place them on the bookshelf, arrange the cushions on the sofa, and return to the living room entrance.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the coffee table in the living room to access the books.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the living room entrance.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the coffee table.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 allows navigation to the pose of a detected or named object (coffee table). This is required to reach the starting point for picking.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick all books from the coffee table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the coffee table with books present.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 (pick_object) secures the target object (books) in the robot gripper. Grounded in MoveIt2 for dexterous manipulation.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the collected books onto the bookshelf.
checkpoints.exit_state: Books are placed on the bookshelf; robot is free.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 (place_object) releases the held object (books) at the target location (bookshelf). Grounded in MoveIt2.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the sofa to access the cushions.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the sofa.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 allows navigation to the pose of the sofa to enable cushion manipulation.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick all cushions from the sofa.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the sofa with cushions present.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 (pick_object) secures the target object (cushions) in the robot gripper.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Arrange the cushions on the sofa.
checkpoints.exit_state: Cushions are arranged on the sofa; robot is free.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 (place_object) releases the held object (cushions) at the target location (sofa).

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the living room entrance.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the living room entrance.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 (navigate_to_room) moves the robot to the requested room (living room). Grounded in Nav2 using the room pose.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base (cannot navigate autonomously). Navigation relies on teleoperation or external path following.
Robot lacks visual perception (no cameras), so object detection and localization must be assumed to be provided via external semantic map or pre-known coordinates.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The plan is logically sound and executable given the abstract skill library. However, due to the robot's fixed-base constraint (can_navigate: false), actual execution requires external teleoperation or a pre-defined path follower to move the robot between locations. The manipulation skills (pick/place) are grounded in MoveIt2 and are executable.
